decision_table.name: Determine_DE_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file Delaware state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in DE (office, employees, property)

condition.name: has_economic_nexus
condition.comment: Meets DE economic nexus threshold ($100,000 or 200 transactions)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Delaware filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Delaware has physical presence nexus when corporation: - Owns or leases real property in Delaware - Maintains employees or agents in Delaware - Has an office or place of business in Delaware
Reference: DE Code Title 30 § 1902 (Corporate income tax) Reference: DE Form 1100 (Delaware Corporation Income Tax Return) Reference: Delaware Division of Revenue Corporate Tax Guidance

Delaware filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair).
Delaware economic nexus thresholds: - $100,000 or more in gross receipts from Delaware, OR - 200 or more separate transactions in Delaware
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: DE Code Title 30 § 1901 (Definitions and general provisions) Reference: Delaware Division of Revenue Economic Nexus Guidance
No Delaware nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_DE_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate Delaware state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
Delaware state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Additions include: - Interest on U.S. government obligations - IRC Section 199A deduction addback - State income taxes deducted federally
Subtractions include: - Interest on Delaware state and local bonds - Delaware NOL deduction (separate from federal NOL)
Reference: DE Form 1100 Instructions (Schedule A - Adjustments to Federal Taxable Income) Reference: DE Code Title 30 § 1903 (Computation of entire net income)
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_DE_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate Delaware state corporate income tax. Applies 8.8% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
Delaware state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to Delaware: × [Apportionment %] 3. State additions: + [Additions] 4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions] 5. Delaware taxable income: = [Result] 6. Delaware tax rate: × 8.8% 7. Delaware income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. Delaware credits: - [Credits] 9. Delaware tax liability: = [Final tax]
Reference: DE Form 1100 (Corporation Income Tax Return) Instructions Reference: DE Code Title 30 § 1902 (Tax rate: 8.8%) Reference: DE Code Title 30 § 1903 (Entire net income computation)
No Delaware nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.
No Delaware taxable income - no tax liability. Delaware NOL rules may apply for future carryforward (not implemented).
